It features a 2560x1440 IPS panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response tuning, integrated USB-C hub, and adjustable stand for multi-use office and home setups. Unlike storage or graphics hardware, this product is a monitor focused on visual output, connectivity, and workspace flexibility.
